name: Chest Press (Machine)
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles are at mid-chest height and sit with your back against the pad.
Grip the handles and retract your shoulder blades.
Press the handles forward until your arms are almost fully extended.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch in the chest without letting the weight stack touch down.
longevityNotes: Pressing strength keeps daily pushing — doors, shelves, getting up from the floor — easy and safe. Controlled pressing builds the shoulders, chest, and arms that protect you in a fall.
overview: A seated machine chest press that trains the chest, shoulders and triceps on a guided path.
